description: Where may a parameter appear in a crosstab, and when is the schema available: a declared Text parameter as a PIVOT IN member, a declared Long in the WHERE, in the TRANSFORM expression, and in an expression PIVOT heading (p & pa), and an undeclared [which g] in the WHERE. For each temporary QueryDef the Parameters (Name, Type, Direction, Value) are read, the QueryDef is opened with nothing assigned (Fields Name/Type/Size, rows, Errors), then the parameter is assigned and the QueryDef is opened again the same way. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text goes into a temporary QueryDef (CreateQueryDef with an empty name, then DBEngine.Errors).
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
